verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents editor features and multi-person editing with revision history, but nothing says which of these, if any, are available on a free tier without a paid seat. Community comments only mention paid editor pricing ($25/$39 per month) and suggest Rive charges for the editor. No evidence establishes free-tier editor or collaboration capability, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
